ssim_method: Channel-average SSIM over the union of source/render foreground pixels (alpha > 0.5), using uniform 7x7 local windows, C1=0.01^2, C2=0.03^2. Original pixel dimensions. This is a defined image-similarity check, not a guarantee of subjective equivalence.
notes: Original source image and prior faithful SVG preserved. Simplified connected shading regions, consolidated tiny solid-color details, fitted linear/radial gradients, and optimized markup. The file remains a detailed trace, with a 0.2px seam-correction effect; it is substantially lighter but is not a simple hand-drawn lettering master.
